purpose: Illustrative Flight Lab design concepts; values, charts, terrain and labels are not simulation results.
replay: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity landscape 16:9 product concept screenshot for TensorAeroSpace Flight Lab, an engineering flight simulation analysis application. This is an illustrative design concept, not a screenshot of an existing feature. Flat screen capture, no laptop or device frame. Professional dark graphite interface, restrained cyan and amber accents, crisp readable English typography, coherent panel spacing. Top bar exact text 'TensorAeroSpace' and 'Flight Lab', navigation 'Replay' 'Scenarios' 'Compare', small badge 'Design concept'. Main central viewport occupies 60%: physically plausible gray F-16 in banked flight above understated mountainous terrain, blue solid actual trajectory and cyan dashed reference trajectory, subtle coordinate axes, small amber highlight at missing left wing tip without explosion, small callout 'Wingtip loss · 20.0 s'. Left sidebar: 'Experiment', 'F-16 nonlinear', 'Controller: AA-INDI', 'Scenario: Wingtip loss', 'Seed: 47'; compact layer checkboxes for 'Trajectory' 'Reference' 'Damage' 'Forces'. Right sidebar title 'Telemetry', a few clearly readable sample values with SI units: 'Airspeed 200 m/s', 'Altitude 2500 m', 'Roll 12°', 'AoA 4°'; underneath aircraft silhouette damage schematic with one tip amber and remaining parts neutral, title 'Aircraft health'. Bottom third contains three aligned line charts labeled 'Roll tracking', 'Actuator input', 'Tracking error' with same vertical orange event cursor at 20 s. Unified replay timeline below with play button, 't = 24.6 s', '1×', event tick at 20 s, buttons 'Export report' and 'Save replay'. The charts and viewport visibly share one cursor. Include tiny legend 'Illustrative data'. Prioritize legible short labels, realistic engineering visualization, no unrelated logos, no battle imagery, no exaggerated holograms, no excessive glowing borders.
scenarios: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high fidelity landscape 16:9 flat screenshot of the proposed TensorAeroSpace Flight Lab 'Scenarios' workspace for visual flight simulation authoring. Companion to a professional dark graphite flight replay application with cyan trajectory lines and amber fault markers; crisp English text, restrained engineering software aesthetic. No device frame. Header exact text 'TensorAeroSpace' 'Flight Lab', tabs 'Replay' 'Scenarios' 'Compare', top right 'Design concept'. Left panel 'Scenario setup' with readable short fields: 'Aircraft: F-16', 'Controller: AA-INDI', 'Duration: 60 s', 'Seed: 47'. Beneath 'Environment', a wind arrow and controls 'Wind speed 8 m/s', 'Direction 270°', 'Sensor noise Low'. Center wide 3D map viewport viewed obliquely from above showing one physically plausible F-16 flying above subdued terrain, cyan planned flight route with four numbered waypoint pins, blue actual trajectory preview, dashed wind vectors, coordinate grid, neat annotation 'Recovery segment'. The right panel 'Selected event' displays a clear aircraft top-view schematic, LEFT wingtip highlighted amber, readable fields 'Wingtip loss', 'Time 20.0 s', 'Section Left tip', 'Loss 100%'; button 'Apply event'. Lower quarter is a visual scenario timeline titled 'Scenario timeline' spanning 0 to 60 seconds: distinct horizontal tracks 'Reference', 'Wind', 'Damage'; teal reference segments, a teal wind interval, one amber 'Wingtip loss' event block starting at 20 s; no extra unexplained events. Bottom footer 'Validate scenario', 'Run simulation', 'Export config' buttons and small 'Illustrative preview'. Interface clearly shows authoring references, disturbances and faults that later feed a simulation, with crisp readable big labels and balanced panels. This is a concept visualization with illustrative data, not validated results. Avoid node spaghetti, fictional performance claims, excessive glow, battle scenes, missiles, unrelated logos, meaningless microtext.
